title: Stremio add-on collection v1
description: The load-bearing structural contract only: an array of descriptor objects, each with a manifest object that has a non-empty string id and a non-empty transportUrl string. Every other field - including unknown keys and unusual-but-preservable values such as a null idPrefixes - is left to the semantic checks in stremioctl.validation, which report them as warnings rather than errors.
